name: tadalafil
indications_original: Tadalafil Tablets are phosphodiesterase 5 (PDE5) inhibitor indicated for the treatment of: erectile dysfunction (ED) ( 1.1 ) the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) ( 1.2 ) ED and the signs and symptoms of BPH (ED/BPH) ( 1.3 ) If Tadalafil Tablets are used with finasteride to initiate BPH treatment, such use is recommended for up to 26 weeks ( 1.4 ).
contraindications_original: Do not split Tadalafil Tablets; entire dose should be taken.
adverseReactions_original: Administration of Tadalafil Tablets to patients using any form of organic nitrate is contraindicated. Tadalafil Tablets was shown to potentiate the hypotensive effect of nitrates ( 4.1 ). History of known serious hypersensitivity reaction to tadalafil tablets or ADCIRCA ® ( 4.2 ). Administration with guanylate cyclase (GC) stimulators, such as riociguat ( 4.3 ).
